name: Helio
source:
The second prince of the Yellow Kingdom and Beryl's younger brother. Childlike, innocent and friendly. However, his words are sometimes tainted with malice and he may show a calculating nature that doesn't match his age. 

"Big brother! So you were here already?"

[Adapted from [url=https://game.mba-international.jp/monomagiacantabile/]official website[/url]]
